product.name: Maintenance Tracking
product.description: A feature that monitors vehicle maintenance schedules and sends reminders for upcoming services to keep the car in good condition.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A tool to track and manage car-related expenses such as fuel, parking fees, and maintenance costs, providing insights into spending patterns.

product.name: Chat Support
product.description: Access to a mechanical engineer via chat for professional assistance and advice related to vehicle maintenance and issues.

product.name: Free Notes
product.description: A note-taking feature that allows users to record personal maintenance insights, memorable moments, or DIY fixes related to their vehicle.
